title: Q-FIND-unlearn: make https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/ findable (3 gaps)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** findable workflow, daily
**Done check:** python3 -m foundation findable --probe unlearn
**Status:** open

https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/ is missing what search engines and AI agents read: Open Graph title; schema.org JSON-LD; no llms.txt. Fix the property's own pages (shared seed modules first, so every system gets it). Closed by the same daily reading.
